_help: Numbers the job finder's code reads. Keys starting with _ are notes.
_pay: Base salary in whole dollars, matching targets.md, e.g. floor 120000, target_low 130000, target_high 150000. Until these are set the report shows pay without colors.
_stale_days: A listing this many days old or older is flagged as stale (a ghost-listing signal).
_test_mode: Keeps LinkedIn to 6 requests a day. Set to false once a few days of runs look healthy.
_private_terms: Words that must never appear in a shared copy of the kit (your last name, employers, email). package.py refuses to build a copy containing them.
